description: Campaign 026 visual identity rebuild. The orchestrator owns the shared identity surfaces (theme tokens, contrast harness, UI kit, shell chrome, game chrome, docs, scripts, generated files); surface packets own disjoint route/component directories and must report shared-file needs instead of editing them. Mechanics files are out of scope for every packet.

parallelPackets.objective: Recompose Home, the Games library and game detail on the new identity: one hero loop, identity-coloured catalog, single-path resume block, designed empty/featured treatments.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Surfaces use kit primitives and tokens only; every existing testID and route intact; the screen-specific tests pass; a native capture shows the recomposition.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app/__tests__/games-library.test.tsx src/app/__tests__/app-shell.test.tsx

parallelPackets.objective: Recompose the Progress suite as identity chart cards with readable axes/zero states, insight pairs and a rhythm view.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Progress surfaces use identity colours per domain/metric, designed empty states, and keep every testID; progress tests pass.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app/__tests__/progress-detail.test.tsx src/app/__tests__/progress-insights.test.tsx src/analytics/__tests__/progress-screens.test.tsx

parallelPackets.objective: Recompose Profile, Rewards and Data management: hero metric grid with one accent card, badge gallery with three achievement states, designed empty/backup states.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Reward states are visually distinct; every testID intact; the route tests pass.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app/__tests__/data-management.test.tsx

parallelPackets.objective: Recompose Results (celebration-first, equal metric columns, one CTA) and the workout surfaces on the new identity.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Results leads with the outcome and keeps every results-* selector; workout suite tests pass.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app/__tests__/results-workout-cta.test.tsx src/workout
